_comment: SUBAGENT spawn map only (never overrides the human's interactive model). Three rungs: junior = bounded child with a runnable check; senior = the interactive parent (set in the product UI, listed here only so the ladder is visible); escalation = fresh child after STUCK or a failed check. Seniority follows model size and effort: seniors wrangle more context and uncertainty, juniors are well scoped. Only Codex has a real model spread today; the other platforms ladder by effort on their one good model. Snapshot 2026-09-18: API Pareto is GPT-heavy; this host follows subscription quota. Soft nudge via scripts/guardlib/model_family.py. Cursor Task has no separate effort field (slug suffix). Codex has no model_family adapter yet; slugs here are for parents reading the file.

snapshot.source: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index vs Cost (API list prices)

rungs.junior: bounded child: goal, allowed paths, runnable check, budget; returns the fixed report
rungs.senior: the parent session: holds context, plans, dispatches, re-runs checks, escalates to the human
rungs.escalation: fresh child after `STUCK: out of ideas.` or a failed check; never resume the stuck child
